_read_me: Settings for the sales board engine. Plain rules a person can change. Settings the engine tunes for itself live in memory/tuned.json, not here.

same_day_weight._read_me: How much a same-day close counts on top of a close. 'data' = the engine works it out every week from what same-day sales are worth vs later sales (contract size, profit %, cancels). Put a number instead to lock it.

note_signals.selling: selling|sale of (?:the )?home|bought the house|just bought|new home|moving
note_signals.firstcall: first (?:call|appt|appointment|one)|hasn'?t met|has not met|haven'?t met|not met with|no other
note_signals.shopper: price shop|met with (?:\d|one|two|three|a few|other|others|multiple|several)|other quotes|quotes from|getting (?:quotes|estimates)
note_signals.urgent: asap|as soon as|urgent|right away|emergency|this week|before winter|quick|fast
note_signals.both: both (?:home|there|present)|husband and wife|wife and husband|spouse|both decision|decision makers? (?:will be|are) (?:home|present|there)

assignment._read_me: Rules the engine follows when it hands out appointments. It picks the plan with the most expected closes (close chance + same-day weight x same-day chance) that fits these rules. Bonuses and penalties are in close-chance points: 0.10 = 10 points.

weekly_capacity._note: Tenured 10 is a minimum we want to give them. Newer 7 is a cap unless the rep closes at or above the team (strong closer).

overbooking._read_me: Rule bends. Used only when an appointment would otherwise have nobody, so the homeowner is not rescheduled. Penalty is subtracted from that pick's value (0.50 = 50 points), which keeps the engine from bending a rule just to squeeze in a better closer.

specialty._note: Specialty roofs: Francesco only; Meinardus when Francesco is full.

commercial._note: Commercial and flat: Meinardus first, Dietrich backup (rather not).

office._note: Bohemia. Mon, Tue, Thu (Mon=0) reps start from the office.

days_off._read_me: Dates a rep is out, like {"Joseph Young": ["2026-10-15"]}.
